credibility.line: Mixed record: top‑line target met, margin target missed, many promises unverified.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management said margins would improve, yet EBITDA% dropped 200 bps.
Revenue growth of 17% FY26 validates the 15% top‑line promise.
No data provided for advertising‑revenue target, so story lacks evidence.

bull: Revenue rose 17% YoY FY26, beating the 15% growth promise.
EBITDA absolute value reached 1,902 cr in FY26, showing profit scale.
Operating cash flow hit 1,894 cr FY26, indicating strong cash conversion.
bear: EBITDA margin fell 200 bps, opposite of the 3‑year improvement pledge.
EBIT margin stayed ~9‑10%, far below the 15% pre‑Ind AS margin goal.
Leverage remains high with D/E at 1.95 as of Sep 2026.
watch: Will EBITDA margin rebound to 22% by FY29?
Advertising revenue contribution to reach 1% of sales.
Actual restaurant openings versus 230‑250 target for FY27.
